svg.title: How toon-crew works
svg.desc: How toon-crew works, in four comic panels. 1: You ask Doraemon in plain words: "Add a dark mode toggle, please." He says "On it!" 2: Doraemon plans and briefs the crew; the queue shows Nobita: design it, Shinchan: build it, Joe: test it. 3: The crew works in parallel at their desks; the guard is on and asks you before risky steps. 4: Pull request 42 has passing checks and needs your OK; you say "Merge it." and Mike and Sulley of the DevOps Team say "Merged!"

g.text: It asks you before risky steps
